title: pr-checks.yml: the doc check never warns, and the commit-message check always warns
objective: In `.github/workflows/pr-checks.yml`, the check-documentation job checks out at the default depth, so `origin/main` is missing, its `git diff` fails inside the `if`, and the job never warns. Give it `fetch-depth: 0`, as the commit-message job has. The commit-message job also reads GitHub's own merge commit, whose subject is longer than 72 characters, so it warns on every pull request: skip that commit.
